title: Cohort snapshot accounting excludes multi-buffer optimizer tasks at default shapes under paired-metal v2

evidence.note: run_fault broker_fault at evaluation stage, turn 2: 'search Evaluation has no final receipt: evaluator_failed', job metal-07b466973089, all counters zero
observer stderr: "ValueError: Metal observer failed or changed its admission: {'code': 1, 'description': 'cohort snapshot payload exceeds 64 MiB bound before dispatch', 'domain': 'main.Refusal'}"
same task at columns=512 completed four turns, protocol adhered (exit 0) - the bound is shape-dependent, not model-dependent

bound formula applied prospectively to a new task: 5-tensor ABI at columns=768 (491,520 elements, ~52.6 MiB per cohort) passed cohort admission through ten evaluations and four turns - the fault that ended this run was unrelated (F-2026-09-10-008). Generalizes the safe rule to ntensor*rows*columns <= 599,186

observation: evaluation/metal/observer.swift:70-72 charges the full tensor ABI of the participant for every launch in a contiguous cohort, and tasks/normalization/study.py:40 schedules 28 route calls per cohort under fixed_baseline_paired_metal_v2. adamw's 7-tensor ABI at 128x1024 fp32 is 3.5 MiB per launch, so a cohort accumulates ~98 MiB against the observer's hard 64 MiB admission bound and is refused before any dispatch. Any multi-buffer optimizer task at default shape fails deterministically at first evaluation. Safe bound at v2 defaults: rows*columns <= 85,600 per 7-tensor ABI (columns=512 gives 49 MiB).
proposed_change: Charge cohort snapshots for what correctness actually needs (outputs plus input integrity), or dedupe repeated identical input payloads within a cohort, so the bound scales with what is verified rather than with launches times ABI. Until then, register per-task shape limits in the workload notes so launcher defaults stay inside the bound.
verification_plan: Capability tick, campaign-verified: an adamw campaign at the default 128x1024 shape must reach evaluation and complete under the successor revision; no CLI shape shrink required.
